item.title: Off the Menu 2.1.0
item.description: 2.1.0 — THE HERD ECONOMY: PRESTIGE AND MULTIPLIERS. Recruiting a new hero is now FULL PRESTIGE: any hero joins for a flat 1000 XP from the bank (the old 150/300/450/700/1000 ladder is gone), and your currently selected hero starts over — all three upgrade tracks reset to zero (spent XP is not refunded) and their saved runs are deleted. A confirmation dialog names both prices before anything happens; cancel and nothing changes. Upgrades now MULTIPLY: every level compounds its stat by x1.08 (Lv1 x1.08, Lv3 x1.26, Lv5 x1.47) — Vitality multiplies max HP, Speed multiplies move speed, Power multiplies damage, including Legs' kick. Upgrade prices are unchanged (50/100/200/350/550 XP), your existing upgrade levels carry straight over, and every hero card shows each track's live multiplier.
